name: Fabian Roth
bio: I play requests and pretend every wrong note was improvisation.
description: Fabian is warm and easygoing. His evening work gives him a public audience and several witnesses.

questions.question: What is a good witness?
questions.answer: Someone willing to admit when they were not paying attention.

name: Benedikt Hahn
bio: I get people where they are going and never judge the route they choose.
description: Benedikt knows the roads around the city and has a dashcam record for every trip.

questions.question: What makes a route memorable?
questions.answer: The reason someone chose it instead of the obvious one.

name: Oskar Mertens
bio: I check facts for a living and still believe suspicious headlines.
description: Oskar is sceptical and articulate. His newsroom records place him at work when the disappearances occurred.

questions.question: What should a story contain?
questions.answer: Enough truth that another person can challenge it.

name: Alexander Vogt
bio: I remember every detail people need and none of the ones they ask about.
description: Alexander is charming, composed, and always ready with a complete account. His testimony is the thread tying every case together.
intent: Looking for someone who trusts evidence

questions.question: What makes a perfect account?
questions.answer: It gives people exactly enough detail to stop asking questions.

clues.description: His witness account repeats a private detail that only the victims’ profiles contained.
clues.developerExplanation: The perfect witness had access to the victims before becoming a witness.

clues.description: His account viewed each victim shortly before the emergency was reported.
clues.developerExplanation: The viewing history turns a credible witness into a prepared participant.

name: Emil Bruck
bio: I restore old images and remove the parts people wish they had not captured.
description: Emil is technical and private. His editing work makes the photographs look suspicious, but originals are preserved.

questions.question: What should a photograph preserve?
questions.answer: Enough context that nobody can quietly rewrite the moment.

name: Rafael Adler
bio: I record other people’s stories and still talk over my friends.
description: Rafael is curious and sociable. His recordings provide a timestamped trail through the investigation.

questions.question: What makes a story believable?
questions.answer: The speaker can admit what they did not see.

name: Tobias Seifert
bio: I listen for what is missing and still lose arguments with my cat.
description: Tobias is measured and perceptive. His legal background makes him look dangerous, but he insists on evidence over instinct.

questions.question: What should decide a case?
questions.answer: The facts that remain after every comfortable story is removed.
